# Needy Streamer Overload media-player frame

`needy-streamer-window.png` is sourced from [lezzthanthree/Needy-Streamer-Overload](https://github.com/lezzthanthree/Needy-Streamer-Overload), which is MIT licensed. It was used here with the profile owner's approval as the frame for the former generated On Rotation card. The source asset is retained for attribution and is no longer displayed in the profile.
